badshahi.name: Badshahi Mosque
badshahi.price_text: Free entry; small fee may apply for the museum
badshahi.hours: Open daily roughly 05:00–22:00; closed to tourists during prayers · check on the day
badshahi.tip: Come in the late afternoon for soft light on the red sandstone. Remove shoes and cover arms and legs.

fort.name: Lahore Fort
fort.price_text: Ticket price varies; check on the day
fort.hours: Daily roughly 08:30–17:00 · check on the day
fort.tip: See the Sheesh Mahal (Hall of Mirrors) and the Alamgiri Gate. Wear shoes you can walk in on uneven stone.

minar.name: Minar-e-Pakistan
minar.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
minar.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–20:00 · check on the day
minar.tip: Climb the tower for a view over the fort and mosque. The surrounding park is busy in the evening.

shalimar.name: Shalimar Gardens
shalimar.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
shalimar.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–18:00 · check on the day
shalimar.tip: A Mughal garden with terraces and fountains. Go early; there is little shade at midday.

anarkali.name: Anarkali Bazaar
anarkali.price_text: Free to walk; pay per item
anarkali.hours: Shops roughly 11:00–21:00; many close Friday midday · check on the day
anarkali.tip: Haggle politely and keep bags in front of you. Try the food stalls in the side lanes.

joyland.name: Joyland
joyland.price_text: Ride tickets sold separately; check on the day
joyland.hours: Daily roughly 14:00–22:00 · check on the day
joyland.tip: An old family amusement park. Good for kids; check ride safety yourself.

wazirkhan.name: Wazir Khan Mosque
wazirkhan.hours: Open daily; closed to tourists during prayers · check on the day
wazirkhan.tip: Famous for tile work. Walk the lanes of the old city around it.

foodstreet.name: Gawalmandi Food Street
foodstreet.price_text: Pay per dish; budget to mid-range
foodstreet.hours: Evening only, roughly 18:00–01:00 · check on the day
foodstreet.tip: Classic Lahori street food: grilled meat, karahi and sweets. Go with an appetite and cash.

fortroad.name: Fort Road Food Street
fortroad.hours: Evening, roughly 17:00–00:00 · check on the day
fortroad.tip: Rooftop restaurants with a view of Badshahi Mosque. Book a rooftop table at sunset.

liberty.name: Liberty Market
liberty.price_text: Free to walk; pay per item
liberty.hours: Shops roughly 11:00–22:00 · check on the day
liberty.tip: Big shopping area for clothes and shoes. Fix a price before you buy.

gulberg.name: MM Alam Road and Gulberg walk
gulberg.price_text: Free to walk; pay at cafes
gulberg.hours: Cafes and shops roughly 11:00–23:00 · check on the day
gulberg.tip: Modern Lahore: cafes, restaurants and shops. Good for an easy evening stroll.

museum.name: Lahore Museum
museum.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
museum.hours: Closed some days; roughly 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
museum.tip: Holds Mughal and Sikh-era collections. Go in the heat of the day.

bagh.name: Bagh-e-Jinnah (Lawrence Gardens)
bagh.hours: Daily, daylight hours · check on the day
bagh.tip: Large green park for a shaded walk. Good break between sights.

tour.name: Old City walking tour
tour.price_text: Guided tours vary; agree the price first
tour.hours: Book ahead; morning or late afternoon
tour.tip: A local guide helps in the narrow lanes. Agree the price and length before you start.

delhi.name: Delhi Gate and old city lanes
delhi.hours: Daylight hours; busiest in the evening
delhi.tip: Enter the walled city here and wander the bazaars. Keep valuables close.
